newsitem.title: USA: Adolph Coors sees price-off trend continue.
newsitem.headline: Adolph Coors sees price-off trend continue.

text.p: Adolph Coors Co said Thursday it expects the trend of competitive price-off activity, which escalated as the summer season began, to continue for the balance of 1997.
The company also said its outlook for cost of goods appears encouraging for the second half, and it is now "driving through the summer season" with strong trends in its core business.
In the second quarter, the company said it maintained momentum in its core business while controlling costs as it entered the peak summer season.
It said its second quarter increases were supported by higher sales revenues, significant productivity in cost of sales, and stronger international income.
The company reported second quarter earnings per share of $1.36 compared to $0.63 for the same period a year ago.
Excluding special items, earnings per share were $0.97 compared to $0.71 a year ago.
The company also said Coors Light continued to grow in mid-single digits at retail.
It also said international business in Canada and the Caribbean contributed to the company's positive results.
